The '''unsafe house''' was an abandoned warehouse on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] used by [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit,<ref name="Mercy Kill" /> in [[44 ABY]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> as part of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] heist. The Wraiths quickly left the unsafe house after discovery by law enforcement, making a clean getaway.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
